fullText.simplified:
我们跑吧？

    十天后，孙策进了江东。
    刘要早就听说孙策要来，他几天前就准备好了。现在，曲阿城外的大路上都是他的军队。他在等孙策，一场大仗要开始了。
    但是，刘要等了六天，也没有等到孙策。刘要觉得很奇怪，他心想，是孙策不敢来了吗？
    第七天，有人着急地对他说：“大人，不好了！孙策打到您家里去了！”
    “什么？”刘要不敢相信自己的耳朵，“孙策不来曲阿，去我家那边了？”
    刘要的家离曲阿有点儿远，他马上带着军队往家跑，他要回去帮忙。他很着急，觉得军队跑得太慢。他大声说：“快点儿！快点儿！”
    天气很热，每个人都累极了，很快就跑不动了。
    刘要很生气，又想说“快点儿”，一个助手从前面跑回来，一边跑一边大声说：“大人，孙策已经回来了！现在他的军队就在前面，他们打过来了！”
    “什么？”刘要又不敢相信自己的耳朵了。
    那个助手刚说完，军队马上就不安静了。大家又累又热，早就跑不动了，现在听说孙策的军队就在前面，都害怕得脸都白了。
    有人小声问：“我们跑吧？”马上就有人跟着说：“我们跑吧！”
    “快跑啊！”有人放下刀，飞快地跑了。马上有更多人放下刀，跟着一起跑了。
    刘要大声说：“不要跑！不要跑！”但是这时候没人听他的话了，军队已经乱了。
    一队人马从前面杀了过来！最前面的那个人拿着刀，穿着白衣，骑着白马。
    那是孙策！
fullText.traditional:
我們跑吧？

    十天後，孫策進了江東。
    劉要早就聽說孫策要來，他幾天前就準備好了。現在，曲阿城外的大路上都是他的軍隊。他在等孫策，一場大仗要開始了。
    但是，劉要等了六天，也沒有等到孫策。劉要覺得很奇怪，他心想，是孫策不敢來了嗎？
    第七天，有人著急地對他說：“大人，不好了！孫策打到您家裡去了！”
    “什麼？”劉要不敢相信自己的耳朵，“孫策不來曲阿，去我家那邊了？”
    劉要的家離曲阿有點兒遠，他馬上帶著軍隊往家跑，他要回去幫忙。他很著急，覺得軍隊跑得太慢。他大聲說：“快點兒！快點兒！”
    天氣很熱，每個人都累極了，很快就跑不動了。
    劉要很生氣，又想說“快點兒”，一個助手從前面跑回來，一邊跑一邊大聲說：“大人，孫策已經回來了！現在他的軍隊就在前面，他們打過來了！”
    “什麼？”劉要又不敢相信自己的耳朵了。
    那個助手剛說完，軍隊馬上就不安靜了。大家又累又熱，早就跑不動了，現在聽說孫策的軍隊就在前面，都害怕得臉都白了。
    有人小聲問：“我們跑吧？”馬上就有人跟著說：“我們跑吧！”
    “快跑啊！”有人放下刀，飛快地跑了。馬上有更多人放下刀，跟著一起跑了。
    劉要大聲說：“不要跑！不要跑！”但是這時候沒人聽他的話了，軍隊已經亂了。
    一隊人馬從前面殺了過來！最前面的那個人拿著刀，穿著白衣，騎著白馬。
    那是孫策！

sentences.pinyin: shí tiān hòu sūn cè jìn le jiāng dōng
sentences.english: Ten days later, Sun Ce entered Jiangdong.

sentences.english: Liu Yao had already heard that Sun Ce was coming, so he was ready several days before.

sentences.english: Now, the main road outside of Qu’a was filled with his troops.

sentences.pinyin: tā zài děng sūn cè yì cháng dà zhàng yào kāi shǐ le
sentences.english: He was waiting for Sun Ce. A big battle was about to begin.

sentences.simplified: 但是，刘要等了六天，也没有等到孙策。

sentences.english: But, Liu Yao waited for six days and still did not encounter Sun Ce.

sentences.traditional: 劉要覺得很奇怪，他心想，是孫策不敢來了嗎？

sentences.english: Liu Yao felt that this was very strange. He thought to himself, is Sun Ce too afraid to come?

sentences.simplified: 第七天，有人着急地对他说：“大人，不好了！孙策打到您家里去了！”

sentences.english: On the seventh day, someone said to him anxiously, “Lord, something bad has happened. Sun Ce has attacked your home!”

sentences.simplified: “什么？”刘要不敢相信自己的耳朵，“孙策不来曲阿，去我家那边了？”
sentences.traditional: “什麼？”劉要不敢相信自己的耳朵，“孫策不來曲阿，去我家那邊了？”
sentences.pinyin: shén me liú yào bù gǎn xiāng xìn zì jǐ de ěr duo sūn cè bù lái qǔ ā qù wǒ jiā nà bian le
sentences.english: “What?” Liu Yao couldn’t believe his ears: “Sun Ce isn’t coming to Qu’a. He went to my home instead?”

sentences.simplified: 刘要的家离曲阿有点儿远，他马上带着军队往家跑，他要回去帮忙。
sentences.traditional: 劉要的家離曲阿有點兒遠，他馬上帶著軍隊往家跑，他要回去幫忙。

sentences.english: Liu Yao’s home was quite far from Qu’a. He immediately ran to his home, taking his troops with him. He wanted to go back and help.

sentences.simplified: 他很着急，觉得军队跑得太慢。他大声说：“快点儿！快点儿！”
sentences.traditional: 他很著急，覺得軍隊跑得太慢。他大聲說：“快點兒！快點兒！”
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn zháo jí jué de jūn duì pǎo de tài màn tā dà shēng shuō kuài diǎn'r kuài diǎn'r
sentences.english: He was very anxious and felt that his troops were running too slowly. He said loudly, “Faster! Faster!”

sentences.simplified: 天气很热，每个人都累极了，很快就跑不动了。
sentences.traditional: 天氣很熱，每個人都累極了，很快就跑不動了。
sentences.pinyin: tiān qì hěn rè měi ge rén dōu lèi jí le hěn kuài jiù pǎo bú dòng le
sentences.english: It was very hot, and everyone was so tired that they soon couldn’t run anymore.

sentences.simplified: 刘要很生气，又想说“快点儿”，一个助手从前面跑回来，
sentences.traditional: 劉要很生氣，又想說“快點兒”，一個助手從前面跑回來，
sentences.pinyin: liú yào hěn shēng qì yòu xiǎng shuō kuài diǎn'r yí ge zhù shǒu cóng qián miàn pǎo huí lai
sentences.english: Liu Yao was very angry and wanted to say “faster” again when an assistant came running back.

sentences.simplified: 一边跑一边大声说：“大人，孙策已经回来了！现在他的军队就在前面，他们打过来了！”
sentences.traditional: 一邊跑一邊大聲說：“大人，孫策已經回來了！現在他的軍隊就在前面，他們打過來了！”
sentences.pinyin: yì biān pǎo yì biān dà shēng shuō dà ren sūn cè yǐ jīng huí lái le xiàn zài tā de jūn duì jiù zài qián miàn tā men dǎ guò lái le
sentences.english: The assistant was shouting as he ran: “Lord, Sun Ce has returned! His troops are ahead of us. They’ve fought their way over!”

sentences.simplified: “什么？”刘要又不敢相信自己的耳朵了。
sentences.traditional: “什麼？”劉要又不敢相信自己的耳朵了。
sentences.pinyin: shén me liú yào yòu bù gǎn xiāng xìn zì jǐ de ěr duo le
sentences.english: “What?” Liu Yao once again couldn’t believe his ears.

sentences.simplified: 那个助手刚说完，军队马上就不安静了。
sentences.traditional: 那個助手剛說完，軍隊馬上就不安靜了。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge zhù shǒu gāng shuō wán jūn duì mǎ shàng jiù bù ān jìng le
sentences.english: After the assistant finished speaking, the troops immediately became restless.

sentences.simplified: 大家又累又热，早就跑不动了，
sentences.traditional: 大家又累又熱，早就跑不動了，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā yòu lèi yòu rè zǎo jiù pǎo bú dòng le
sentences.english: Everyone was tired and hot. They couldn’t run anymore.

sentences.simplified: 现在听说孙策的军队就在前面，都害怕得脸都白了。
sentences.traditional: 現在聽說孫策的軍隊就在前面，都害怕得臉都白了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tīng shuō sūn cè de jūn duì jiù zài qián miàn dōu hài pà de liǎn dōu bái le
sentences.english: Now they heard that Sun Ce’s army was just ahead, they were so scared that their faces went pale.

sentences.simplified: 有人小声问：“我们跑吧？”马上就有人跟着说：“我们跑吧！”
sentences.traditional: 有人小聲問：“我們跑吧？”馬上就有人跟著說：“我們跑吧！”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén xiǎo shēng wèn wǒ men pǎo ba mǎ shàng jiù yǒu rén gēn zhe shuō wǒ men pǎo ba
sentences.english: Some people asked quietly, “Let’s run?” Immediately some other people said, “Let’s run!”

sentences.simplified: “快跑啊！”有人放下刀，飞快地跑了。
sentences.traditional: “快跑啊！”有人放下刀，飛快地跑了。

sentences.english: “Quick, run!” Some people put down their swords and started running away at lightning speed.

sentences.simplified: 马上有更多人放下刀，跟着一起跑了。
sentences.traditional: 馬上有更多人放下刀，跟著一起跑了。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ shàng yǒu gèng duō rén fàng xià dāo gēn zhe yì qǐ pǎo le
sentences.english: Right away, more people put down their swords and ran after them.

sentences.simplified: 刘要大声说：“不要跑！不要跑！”但是这时候没人听他的话了，军队已经乱了。
sentences.traditional: 劉要大聲說：“不要跑！不要跑！”但是這時候沒人聽他的話了，軍隊已經亂了。
sentences.pinyin: liú yào dà shēng shuō bú yào pǎo bú yào pǎo dàn shì zhè shí hou méi rén tīng tā de huà le jūn duì yǐ jīng luàn le
sentences.english: Liu Yao said loudly, “Don’t run! Don’t run!” But at this time, no one was listening to him anymore. The army was in chaos.

sentences.simplified: 一队人马从前面杀了过来！
sentences.traditional: 一隊人馬從前面殺了過來！
sentences.pinyin: yí duì rén mǎ cóng qián miàn shā le guò lái
sentences.english: Troops attacked them from the front!

sentences.simplified: 最前面的那个人拿着刀，穿着白衣，骑着白马。
sentences.traditional: 最前面的那個人拿著刀，穿著白衣，騎著白馬。
sentences.pinyin: zuì qián miàn de nà ge rén ná zhe dāo chuān zhe bái yī qí zhe bái mǎ
sentences.english: The man at the very front was holding a sword, wearing white clothes, and riding a white horse.

sentences.simplified: 那是孙策！
sentences.traditional: 那是孫策！
sentences.pinyin: nà shì sūn cè
sentences.english: It was Sun Ce!

sentence_translations: Let’s Run?
Ten days later, Sun Ce entered Jiangdong.
Liu Yao had already heard that Sun Ce was coming, so he was ready several days before.
Now, the main road outside of Qu’a was filled with his troops.
He was waiting for Sun Ce. A big battle was about to begin.
But, Liu Yao waited for six days and still did not encounter Sun Ce.
Liu Yao felt that this was very strange. He thought to himself, is Sun Ce too afraid to come?
On the seventh day, someone said to him anxiously, “Lord, something bad has happened. Sun Ce has attacked your home!”
“What?” Liu Yao couldn’t believe his ears: “Sun Ce isn’t coming to Qu’a. He went to my home instead?”
Liu Yao’s home was quite far from Qu’a. He immediately ran to his home, taking his troops with him. He wanted to go back and help.
He was very anxious and felt that his troops were running too slowly. He said loudly, “Faster! Faster!”
It was very hot, and everyone was so tired that they soon couldn’t run anymore.
Liu Yao was very angry and wanted to say “faster” again when an assistant came running back.
The assistant was shouting as he ran: “Lord, Sun Ce has returned! His troops are ahead of us. They’ve fought their way over!”
“What?” Liu Yao once again couldn’t believe his ears.
After the assistant finished speaking, the troops immediately became restless.
Everyone was tired and hot. They couldn’t run anymore.
Now they heard that Sun Ce’s army was just ahead, they were so scared that their faces went pale.
Some people asked quietly, “Let’s run?” Immediately some other people said, “Let’s run!”
“Quick, run!” Some people put down their swords and started running away at lightning speed.
Right away, more people put down their swords and ran after them.
Liu Yao said loudly, “Don’t run! Don’t run!” But at this time, no one was listening to him anymore. The army was in chaos.
Troops attacked them from the front!
The man at the very front was holding a sword, wearing white clothes, and riding a white horse.
It was Sun Ce!
